destination.name: Broken Hill
destination.tagline: A mining city in the far-west outback with artists' galleries and the Silverton ghost town nearby.
destination.description: Broken Hill is a mining city founded in 1883, the origin of BHP, whose Line of Lode silver-lead-zinc deposit helped put the city on the National Heritage List in 2015. Wikivoyage names its galleries and the artists who made the city home as the other main reason to visit. Silverton, 26 km away, is where Mad Max 2 was filmed, and the Mundi Mundi Lookout beyond it overlooks the plain at sunset. The streets are often named after elements of the periodic table.
whyVisit: Explore Silverton, the old film-set town
Watch sunset from Mundi Mundi Lookout

goodToKnow.title: Central time
goodToKnow.detail: Broken Hill and Silverton run on Australian Central Standard Time, while other NSW towns in the region use Eastern time.

goodToKnow.title: Book Daydream Mine
goodToKnow.detail: Tours run at 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM, on Tuesday to Thursday, Saturday and Sunday in quiet months and daily in school holidays; book ahead.

goodToKnow.title: Mad Max 2 Museum days
goodToKnow.detail: The Silverton museum is closed Monday and Tuesday; the Living Desert Sculptures open at 6:00 AM from December to February, so go early in summer.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The cooler months, {months}, suit walking to the Living Desert Sculptures and underground tours; the sculpture sanctuary opens at 6:00 AM in summer to beat the heat.
